The way we build and run RIAs has changed through three major phases:1.The Plugin Era (Early 2000s): The term "RIA" was first used by Macromedia in 2002 for Flash MX. Back then, you needed extra browser plugins like Adobe Flash, Microsoft Silverlight, or Java Applets to see rich graphics and video. 2.The AJAX Era (Mid-2000s): Developers started using AJAX (Asynchronous JavaScript and XML). This let websites talk to servers behind the scenes without heavy plugins.3.The Modern HTML5 Era (Present): Plugins disappeared due to security and mobile limits. Today, standard HTML5, CSS3, and powerful JavaScript frameworks (like React, Angular, and Vue) power these applications natively inside every browser
